description: antaresRead is an R package for importing and exploring results from Antares electricity-system studies. Its README shows how the readAntares function selects simulations, areas and variables for an R session. Users supply a compatible Antares study directory; outputs are tables and objects ready for plotting or further scenario comparison. Geographic coverage follows the regions in the input Antares model. The package DESCRIPTION states GPL version 2 or later, and the README gives CRAN and GitHub installation routes. A limitation is that reading outputs does not verify the assumptions or convergence of the upstream Antares run. Version compatibility matters if Antares changes its result layout. The tool can prepare dispatch and adequacy outputs for grid resilience or capacity analysis. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS record is a different electricity optimiser. No Antares study files or R package were downloaded.
name: antaresRead simulation-output reader
